template.name: CloudBridge Relay Template
template.description: Template for monitoring CloudBridge Relay Server with AI integration

trigger.name: CloudBridge Relay: no active connections
trigger.description: No active relay connections for 5m (threshold: {$CB.RELAY.MIN_CONN}).

trigger.name: CloudBridge Relay: no data
trigger.description: No data received for relay connections for {$CB.NODATA.WINDOW}.

trigger.name: AI Service is not "{$CB.AI.STATUS}"
trigger.description: AI service status differs from expected "{$CB.AI.STATUS}".

trigger.name: High CPU usage (> {$CB.CPU.HIGH}% for 5m)
trigger.description: CPU usage averaged over 5m is above {$CB.CPU.HIGH}%.

trigger.name: High Memory usage (> {$CB.MEM.HIGH}% for 5m)
trigger.description: Memory usage above {$CB.MEM.HIGH}% for 5m.

trigger.name: High Disk usage (> {$CB.DISK.HIGH}% for 5m)
trigger.description: Disk usage above {$CB.DISK.HIGH}% for 5m.

trigger.name: CPU usage warning (> {$CB.CPU.WARN}% for 5m)
trigger.description: CPU usage averaged over 5m is above {$CB.CPU.WARN}%.

trigger.name: Memory usage warning (> {$CB.MEM.WARN}% for 5m)
trigger.description: Memory usage above {$CB.MEM.WARN}% for 5m.

trigger.name: Disk usage warning (> {$CB.DISK.WARN}% for 5m)
trigger.description: Disk usage above {$CB.DISK.WARN}% for 5m.

trigger.name: AI Service Down
trigger.description: AI service is not responding or unhealthy

trigger.name: AI Service Status Not Running
trigger.description: AI service status is not "{$CB.AI.STATUS}"

trigger.name: AI Circuit Breaker Open
trigger.description: AI circuit breaker is open, indicating high error rate

trigger.name: High AI Processing Time (> {$CB.AI.PROCESSING_TIME.HIGH}ms for 5m)
trigger.description: AI processing time averaged over 5m is above {$CB.AI.PROCESSING_TIME.HIGH}ms

trigger.name: High AI Error Rate (> {$CB.AI.ERROR_RATE.HIGH}% for 5m)
trigger.description: AI error rate averaged over 5m is above {$CB.AI.ERROR_RATE.HIGH}%

trigger.name: Low AI Anomaly Detection Accuracy (< {$CB.AI.ACCURACY.WARN}% for 5m)
trigger.description: AI anomaly detection accuracy below {$CB.AI.ACCURACY.WARN}% for 5m

trigger.name: Low AI Load Prediction Accuracy (< {$CB.AI.ACCURACY.HIGH}% for 5m)
trigger.description: AI load prediction accuracy below {$CB.AI.ACCURACY.HIGH}% for 5m

trigger.name: Low AI Route Optimization Accuracy (< {$CB.AI.ACCURACY.WARN}% for 5m)
trigger.description: AI route optimization accuracy below {$CB.AI.ACCURACY.WARN}% for 5m

trigger.expression: last(/CloudBridge Relay Template/ai.cache_hits)/(last(/CloudBridge Relay Template/ai.cache_hits)+last(/CloudBridge Relay Template/ai.cache_misses))*100<50
trigger.name: Low AI Cache Hit Rate (< 50%)
trigger.description: AI cache hit rate is below 50%

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: No Active Connections
trigger.description: No active P2P QUIC connections for 5m (threshold: {$CB.P2P.CONNECTIONS.MIN})

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: High Latency (> {$CB.P2P.LATENCY.WARN}ms for 5m)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC latency above {$CB.P2P.LATENCY.WARN}ms for 5m

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: Critical Latency (> {$CB.P2P.LATENCY.HIGH}ms for 5m)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC latency above {$CB.P2P.LATENCY.HIGH}ms for 5m

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: Low Inbound Throughput (< {$CB.P2P.THROUGHPUT.MIN} Bps for 5m)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC inbound throughput below {$CB.P2P.THROUGHPUT.MIN} Bps for 5m

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: High Packet Loss (> {$CB.P2P.PACKET_LOSS.WARN} packets)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC packet loss above {$CB.P2P.PACKET_LOSS.WARN} packets

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: Critical Packet Loss (> {$CB.P2P.PACKET_LOSS.HIGH} packets)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC packet loss above {$CB.P2P.PACKET_LOSS.HIGH} packets

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: DDoS Attack Detected (> {$CB.P2P.DDOS.THRESHOLD} attacks blocked)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC DDoS protection blocked more than {$CB.P2P.DDOS.THRESHOLD} attacks

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: Whitelist Violations (> 10 violations)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC whitelist violations above 10

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: Many Fallback Events (> 5 events)
trigger.description: P2P QUIC fallback events above 5 - network issues detected

trigger.name: P2P QUIC: No Active Mesh Routes
trigger.description: P2P QUIC has no active mesh routes
